snippet.title: NEKROTRONIC VR Game Trailer [Free Experience on Steam]
snippet.description:
"Nekrotronic VR is an intensely immersive sci-fi shoot ‘em up. Featuring insane action and creepy ghosts from the feature film Nekrotronic, this VRexperience will get your heart pumping and your hair standing on end."

Available now on Steam for HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, and Valve Index
Developed by: Spectre Studios and Guerilla Films.
Publisher: Roache-Turner Films.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137170/NEKROTRONIC_VR/
https://www.vrexplorer.net/NEKROTRONIC-VR
